To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the thermal conductivity, thermal diffu-sivity, density and kinematic viscosity of cashew apple juice were found to decrease, and the dynamic viscosity and density were found to increase, as the concentration of the cashew apple juice increased.
the thermal conductivity and diffusitivity of cashew juice decrease with increasing concentration, while the density and viscosity increase with increasing concentration.
the thermal properties of cashew juices decrease with the increase in soluble solid content, while the density and viscosity increase.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the determination of physical properties of cashews juice, which is a very important product in the Brazilian economy.
the determination of the physical properties of the cashew juice.
the effect of concentration of cashew juice on the physical properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the thermal properties of cashew juices can be accurately predicted using a linear relationship with soluble solids content.

the thermal conductivity and diffusitivity of cashew juice decrease linearly, density and viscosity increase linearly, and specific heat capacity increases nonlinearly as a function of soluble solids content.
, the increase of the soluble solid content in cashew juice results in the decrease of the thermal conductivity and thermal diffusivity and in the increase of density and viscosity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the physical properties of juice are dependent on its concentration.
the thermal conductivity of cashew juice is lower than that of water.

thermal conductivity, thermal diffu- sivity, viscosity and density are strongly affected by the concentration of soluble solids in cashew juice, and these properties can be predicted using the models presented in this paper.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cashew juice can be considered a low thermal diffusivity liquid.
thermal conductivity and diffusitivity decrease with the increase in soluble solids content, and that the density and viscosity increase with the increase in concentration.
cashew juice can be used as a heat transfer fluid, and its thermal properties can be adjusted by changing the concentration.
